Predict CDCM latent and BOLD signals from posterior draws

predict_cdcm.Rd

Predict CDCM latent and BOLD signals from posterior draws

Usage

predict_cdcm(
  draws_df,
  hypothesis_idxs,
  nscan,
  m,
  n_u,
  TR,
  U,
  check_identifiability = FALSE,
  identifiability_tol = 1e-08
)

Arguments

draws_df

Posterior draws data frame. The first column is assumed to be the log-posterior column, the last three columns are assumed to be draw metadata, and the parameter columns are assumed to be ordered as: noise standard deviations, nu_A, nu_B, nu_C, z0, and beta.

hypothesis_idxs

List of model index matrices containing A_idxs, B_idxs, and C_idxs.

nscan

Number of scan time points.

m

Number of brain regions/ROIs, denoted d in the manuscript.

n_u

Number of stimulus inputs, denoted m in the manuscript.

TR

Repetition time.

U

Input stimulus matrix.

check_identifiability

Logical. If TRUE, runs post-fit plug-in identifiability diagnostics.

identifiability_tol

Numeric tolerance for identifiability diagnostics.

Value

A list containing predicted latent states and predicted BOLD signal, and optional identifiability check.
